reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish, and I buy lighting from Wayfair, Lowe's or West Elm because I know how their returns and delivery work. A $360 pendant I can't judge from photos, from a store with no track record, isn't something I'll gamble on.
objection: I can't tell the quality from photos, and if the paper or the finish looks cheap in person, I'm paying return shipping on a big fixture to a store I don't know.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns, or the same pendant sold through a retailer I already trust like Wayfair or Amazon. Real customer photos and reviews, or a sample of the shade material, would also help.
